encodings.full: designs.lcu_witness: data 0-3, selector 4; x_sign = -1 adds Z on the selector after its first H; compiled at optimization level 0 to cx, rz, h, x, z, s, sdg with Rz on the pi/64 grid
encodings.reduced: selector a = slot qubit 0, data d = slot qubit 1; SELECT = diag(g(L,L'), g(L,U'), g(U,L'), g(U,U')) over (a, d) from the census coefficients, then CNOT(a -> d); x_sign = -1 adds Z on a after its first H
encodings.reduced_cross: selector a, data d, mark w = slot qubits 0, 1, 2; identity diagonal (the census carries no phases for four-label rows, and P = 1/2 for every sign), CNOT(a -> d), CNOT(a -> w)
encodings.ry: Sdag written as Rz(-pi/2); no bit register, measure or comment; the emulator measures every atom at the end

role: smoke subset after R1 passes: the reduced smoke replicas of family (a), the T1 edge and its twist at y_sign +-1, and the (1,10) full Design B dark, bright and fixture witnesses

preregistered.observable: zero-product success P(selector = 0) per replica, selector bits read with qubit 0 leftmost
preregistered.falsifier: a deterministic replica below 0.9 of its ideal outcome is reported with the emulator's raw rates as an emulator rate, never as an algebraic result
preregistered.stop_rule: a deterministic replica below 0.9 of its ideal outcome stops the series
